title: The Static — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 92bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic static noise Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The static is not silence — it's the sound of everything at once
The un-tuned radio between two stations running stunts
White noise is a frequency the brain can almost use
The static lives in gaps between the signals that we choose

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La estática no es silencio — es el sonido de todo a la vez
[The static is not silence — it's the sound of everything at once]
La radio sin sintonía entre dos estaciones tal vez
[The untuned radio between two stations perhaps]
El ruido blanco es una frecuencia que el cerebro casi puede usar
[White noise is a frequency the brain can almost use]
La estática vive en los huecos entre las señales al buscar
[The static lives in the gaps between the signals we seek]

[Chorus — English]
The static holds it all — every signal overlaid
Every frequency that ever existed in cascade
The static is not empty, it's overcrowded, dense with code
The static is the universe before the message has been showed
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La statique n'est pas le silence — c'est tout à la fois
[The static is not silence — it's everything at once]
La radio non accordée entre deux stations qu'on croit
[The untuned radio between two stations we believe]
Le bruit blanc est une fréquence que le cerveau presque saisit
[White noise is a frequency the brain almost grasps]
La statique vit dans les espaces entre les signaux qu'on suit
[The static lives in the gaps between the signals we follow]

[Outro — All three languages]
The static knows everything… La estática lo sabe todo… La statique sait tout
Everything and nothing — Todo y nada — Tout et rien
That's my boy
